ambient: A curtain is drawn round a bed by nobody, briskly, the way it is done.
Far off, a trolley goes over a join in the floor. Twice.
description: Beds down both walls, further than the room goes, every one made with hospital corners and none of them slept in. The floor is polished to a shine that shows the ceiling but not you. At the far end somebody is doing paperwork, and the sound of the pen is very close.
name: The Long Ward

looks: Made so tightly the sheet has stopped being cloth.
Slept in recently, and remade around the shape.
There is a chart at the foot of it. It is your chart. The dates are all today.
objects.name: a bed

looks: You are not in it. The ceiling is, correctly, and the beds are.
You catch yourself in it half a second after you move.
Something walks across it that is not walking across the room.
objects.name: the shine on the floor

weather: The air is the exact temperature of skin, and it is not moving at all.
